key_terms.بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي: An idiom of deep affection meaning 'my father and mother are sacrificed for you'

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the supplication 'Bika Abi wa Ummi' in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This famous supplication, attributed to Imam Ali (peace be upon him) at the Prophet's deathbed, encapsulates the Shia concept of *Wala* (spiritual guardianship) and the Prophet's ongoing intercessory role. It highlights the transition from physical presence to spiritual reliance, emphasizing that the Prophet's care extends beyond his earthly life into the divine court. This phrase is often cited in Shia jurisprudence and theology to support the practice of seeking intercession (*Tawassul*) through the Ahl al-Bayt.
